/// Whether a `Paint` fills a shape or strokes its outline.
/// ```as
/// let paint = new Paint();
/// paint.color = Color.rgb(255, 100, 50);
/// paint.style = PaintStyle.stroke;
/// ```
export const enum PaintStyle {
    /// Draws the outline of the shape.
    stroke = 0,

    /// Fills the inside of the shape.
    fill = 1,
}

/// How two stroke segments are joined at a corner.
/// ```as
/// let paint = new Paint();
/// paint.color = Color.rgb(255, 100, 50);
/// paint.style = PaintStyle.stroke;
/// paint.join = StrokeJoin.round;
/// ```
export const enum StrokeJoin {
    /// Sharp corner.
    miter = 0,

    /// Rounded corner.
    round = 1,

    /// Flattened corner.
    bevel = 2,
}

/// The shape at the ends of open stroke segments.
/// ```as
/// let paint = new Paint();
/// paint.color = Color.rgb(255, 100, 50);
/// paint.style = PaintStyle.stroke;
/// paint.cap = StrokeCap.round;
/// ```
export const enum StrokeCap {
    /// Squared end with no extension.
    butt = 0,

    /// Semicircular cap.
    round = 1,

    /// Squared cap that extends past the end point.
    square = 2,
}

/// How a paint's color or gradient is composited with the content behind it.
/// ```as
/// let paint = new Paint();
/// paint.color = Color.rgb(255, 100, 50);
/// paint.blendMode = BlendMode.multiply;
/// ```
export const enum BlendMode {
    /// Draws over the content behind it. The default.
    srcOver = 3,

    /// Adds the colors, which lightens.
    additive = 12,

    /// Multiplies the inverted colors and inverts the result, which lightens.
    screen = 14,

    /// Multiplies or screens depending on the color behind.
    overlay = 15,

    /// Keeps the darker of the two colors.
    darken = 16,

    /// Keeps the lighter of the two colors.
    lighten = 17,

    /// Brightens the color behind to reflect the paint.
    colorDodge = 18,

    /// Darkens the color behind to reflect the paint.
    colorBurn = 19,

    /// Multiplies or screens depending on the paint color.
    hardLight = 20,

    /// Darkens or lightens depending on the paint color, softer than `hardLight`.
    softLight = 21,

    /// Subtracts the darker color from the lighter one.
    difference = 22,

    /// Like `difference` with lower contrast.
    exclusion = 23,

    /// Multiplies the colors, which darkens.
    multiply = 24,

    /// The hue of the paint with the saturation and luminosity behind.
    hue = 25,

    /// The saturation of the paint with the hue and luminosity behind.
    saturation = 26,

    /// The hue and saturation of the paint with the luminosity behind.
    color = 27,

    /// The luminosity of the paint with the hue and saturation behind.
    luminosity = 28,
}

/// A color stop in a `Gradient`: a position from 0 to 1 and the color there.
export struct GradientStop {
    /// Position of the stop along the gradient, where 0 is the start and 1 is the
    /// end.
    position: f32 = 0;

    /// The `Color` at `position`.
    color: Color = 0;

    /// Creates a stop with `color` at `position`.
    /// ```as
    /// let stops: Array<GradientStop> = [
    ///   GradientStop(0, Color.rgb(255, 0, 0)),
    ///   GradientStop(1, Color.rgb(0, 0, 255)),
    /// ];
    /// ```
    constructor(position: f32, color: Color);
}

/// A gradient for filling or stroking a shape, built from `GradientStop` values
/// as either a linear or a radial gradient. Assign it to `Paint.gradient`.
export class Gradient {
    /// Creates a linear gradient that transitions between `stops` along the line
    /// from `from` to `to`.
    /// ```as
    /// let g = Gradient.linear(Vector.xy(0, 0), Vector.xy(100, 0), [
    ///   GradientStop(0, Color.rgb(255, 0, 0)),
    ///   GradientStop(1, Color.rgb(0, 0, 255)),
    /// ]);
    /// ```
    static linear(from: Vector, to: Vector, stops: Array<GradientStop>): Gradient;

    /// Creates a radial gradient centered at `center` that transitions between
    /// `stops` out to `radius`.
    /// ```as
    /// let g = Gradient.radial(Vector.xy(50, 50), 40, [
    ///   GradientStop(0, Color.rgb(255, 0, 0)),
    ///   GradientStop(1, Color.rgb(0, 0, 255)),
    /// ]);
    /// ```
    static radial(center: Vector, radius: f32, stops: Array<GradientStop>): Gradient;

    /// Frees the gradient's host resources now instead of when it is collected.
    /// Do not use the gradient afterwards.
    release(): void;
}

/// ```

    set color(value: Color);

    /// paint.style = PaintStyle.stroke;

    copy(): Paint;
